desc.script-exec: Run a script on target hosts via a real Task
desc.condition: Evaluate an expression with true / false branches

desc.start: Declare workflow inputs; a run starts here
desc.transform: Reshape upstream output into named fields
desc.ai-analyze: Read upstream output and produce a text conclusion; never executes
desc.end: Aggregate final outputs; the run result comes from here
desc.llm: Generate text or structured JSON with a model; never executes commands

start.when: Every workflow has exactly one start node.
start.output: Each definition.variables entry: run.input.<name> or nodes.start.output.<name>.

end.when: Use when downstream needs a stable result; at most one, with no outgoing edges.
end.output: The config.outputs {name, value} map, i.e. workflow_run.output.

script-exec.purpose: Run a script on target hosts as a real Task.
script-exec.when: Host inspection, operations or changes are needed.
script-exec.input: Upstream output can be injected into script slots through parameters.
script-exec.output: Script stdout (text or JSON, no fixed schema).

transform.purpose: Map upstream output into named fields.
transform.when: Downstream needs stable names or a composed summary.

condition.when: Two IF / ELSE paths are needed.
condition.output: { result: boolean }; true takes the IF edge, false takes ELSE.

ai-analyze.purpose: Read upstream output and produce a conclusion, or structured JSON when requested; never executes commands.
ai-analyze.when: For summaries, judgments or risk verdicts; text suits humans, json suits downstream machine reads.
ai-analyze.input: input template truncated to maxInputChars; in json mode jsonSchema is prompt guidance describing fields and types.
ai-analyze.output: { text, model, truncated }; in json mode the parsed result is returned in text; the schema is guidance only, not local validation.

approval.purpose: Suspend the run until an admin decides.
approval.when: High-risk operations or explicit human confirmation.
approval.input: Upstream output can be embedded in title/detail templates.

notify.purpose: Push the result to configured channels.
notify.when: People need to be told or an audit trail is desired.
notify.input: Upstream output can be embedded in the message template.

wait.purpose: Wait for a number of seconds, then continue.

llm.purpose: Call a general LLM to produce text or structured JSON.
llm.when: When you need summaries, field extraction or machine-readable output, but no command execution; text returns prose, json returns a parsed object.
llm.input: userPrompt / systemPrompt templates, with upstream input truncated to maxInputChars.
llm.output: { text, json, structured, model }; json mode strips ```json fences and parses, retries once with a repair prompt, then fails the node if still invalid.
llm.example:
provider: openai
model: gpt-4o-mini
userPrompt: |
  Analyze ${nodes.check.output} and return a risk verdict
outputMode: json
jsonSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"verdict":{"type":"string"}}}

classifier.purpose: Ask a model to put the input into exactly one class and route by class.
classifier.when: When different problem types (disk / network / permission) need different branches.
classifier.output: { class, reason, raw }; one source handle per class plus a default fallback.

code.purpose: Run data-transformation code in an isolated sandbox and return a JSON-serializable result.
code.when: When upstream JSON needs merging, trimming or reshaping, but no host access is needed.
code.input: inputs mapping (name → ${path} template) becomes the object passed to main(input).
code.output: The return value of main, stored as nodes.<key>.output.

security.title: Security boundaries
security.ai: AI / LLM only produce text or JSON and never execute commands; LLM output cannot be raw script parameters.
security.approval: Approval is the only human authorization path; high-risk scripts need an approval ancestor.
security.script: Scripts still pass the shared risk gate; wrapping them in a workflow does not bypass it.
security.code: The code node runs in an isolated data sandbox with no host IO / commands / network; host operations still use script-exec / agents.
security.host: Host operations only go through script-exec / agent tasks and the shared risk gate plus approval.

aiNodes.title: How LLM / classifier / code nodes work
aiNodes.intro: These three nodes handle understanding and transformation; execution still happens only in script-exec / agents.

llm.desc: Pick a provider/model and write userPrompt (variables can be inserted). text returns plain text; json asks for JSON only, strips ```json fences, parses it and retries once with a repair prompt on failure.

classifier.desc: Define 1..10 classes. Each class creates a visible source handle and is wired by class name; default only catches no-match, and each class / default allows at most one outgoing edge.
classifier.example:
classes: disk / network / permission
edges: disk → cleanup, network → network triage

code.desc: Write main(input) for data transformation (JavaScript or Python). inputs feed upstream values into input; code runs in an isolated sandbox without host IO, commands or network.

template.title: Template gallery
template.intro: Applying a template replaces the canvas (with confirmation); adjust and save afterwards.
template.replaceBody: The canvas already has nodes. Applying a template replaces the whole graph (undo is available).

disk.safeDesc: Demonstrates a disk threshold using a fixed value; it does not collect disk data or send notifications.
disk.name: Disk check and alert
disk.desc: Start → collect disk usage → normalize → alert over threshold → End.

restart.executionWarning: This template can restart a real service and has side effects. Service health is not verified. High-risk approval binding is not implemented, so the command may still be blocked by the risk gate after approval.
restart.safeDesc: Restarts a service after approval, with real side effects. It may send a notification but does not verify service health.
restart.name: Service restart approval
restart.desc: Approve, restart the service, then notify the result.

aiReview.safeDesc: Review a manually supplied observation with AI. The result is advisory and requires human review; no host commands or notifications are issued.
aiReview.externalInputWarning: Configure the default AI provider and model before running. Input is sent to the configured external AI model; enter only non-sensitive information.

health.safeDesc: Demonstrates a count condition using a fixed value; it is not a real health check and sends no notifications.
health.name: Batch health check
health.desc: Probe target hosts, notify on any output, otherwise wait briefly.

llm.warning: The LLM node only produces text or JSON and never executes commands; its output cannot be used as raw script parameters.
llm.userPromptHint: Required template; reference upstream output with ${path}. Long input is truncated to maxInputChars.
llm.systemPromptHint: Optional; constrains role, tone and output format.
llm.outputModeHint: json mode asks for JSON only, strips ```json fences and parses it; one repair retry is attempted on failure.
llm.jsonSchemaHint: Prompt guidance only; invalid JSON here is a publish warning, not local schema validation.
llm.temperatureHint: 0..2; lower is more stable. Structured output works best around 0.1–0.3.
llm.maxInputCharsHint: 1000..32000; the excess is truncated before the model call.

classifier.warning: Classification is only used for routing and never executes commands; each class gets one source handle.
classifier.inputHint: Reference upstream output with ${path}; this is the classifier input.
classifier.inputRequired: Please enter a classifier input template
classifier.classesHint: 1..10, names matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ and unique; each class creates a source handle (one outgoing edge per branch).
classifier.emptyClasses: No classes yet; add at least one class.
classifier.invalidClassName: Class names must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ and be unique:
classifier.invalidClassList: A classifier needs at least one valid, unique class
classifier.tooManyClasses: A classifier supports at most 10 classes
classifier.instructionsHint: Optional extra guidance; the executor already asks for exactly one class.
classifier.instructionsPlaceholder: Classify the operations input into exactly one class.
classifier.outputHint: Outputs { class, reason, raw }; the canvas shows {{count}} class handles plus default.

code.unavailableNotice: Running code requires a configured isolated execution service. If the service is not ready, execution is refused; code never runs locally on the server.
code.warning: The code node only transforms data inside a server-side isolated data sandbox; it has no host file, network or command access.
code.previewNoExecution: A single-node test run is only a preview; it does not execute this code.
code.sampleIsolationUnavailable: The isolated execution service is not ready. The sample cannot run.
code.workflowMemoryRisk: Running code requires a configured isolated execution service. If the service is not ready, execution is refused; code never runs locally on the server.
code.sampleWarning: The sample runs in a real data sandbox. It does not dispatch host tasks or advance the workflow. Do not enter sensitive values.
code.sampleInvalid: Enter a valid JSON object for the sample input (not an array, scalar or null).
code.sampleTimeoutInvalid: Choose a timeout from 1 to 5 whole seconds.
code.sampleServiceUnavailable: The isolated execution service is not ready. Try again when the service is available.
code.sampleError: An error occurred during the sample run.
code.previewOnly: A single-node test run is only a preview and does not execute this code. Run the workflow to execute it in the data sandbox.
code.languageHint: javascript needs main(input); python needs def main(input).
code.codeHint: Up to 20,000 chars; the return value must be JSON-serializable.
code.inputsHint: Name → upstream variable template; becomes the object passed to main(input).
code.inputContract: Input names become properties of the object passed to main(input). Use upstream variable templates; names must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits or underscores, up to 64 characters.
code.inputsEmpty: No inputs yet; main(input) receives an empty object.
code.timeoutSecHint: 1..5 seconds; execution is cancelled on expiry.
code.outputHint: Output is the JSON return value of main, up to 8 KiB. Arrays and scalars are exposed under result.
code.outputContract: Return a JSON-compatible object, array or scalar. Return an object to expose named fields. Output fields depend on the return value; output schema validation is not yet supported.

condition.builderHint: Compose the expression with structured fields; the advanced input always stores the final text.
condition.advancedHint: Supports paths / numbers / single-quoted strings / == != > < >= <= contains / && ||, up to 512 chars.
condition.advancedOnlyDesc: The structured builder only expresses a single condition; keep editing in the advanced input — the stored value is still that raw text.
